title: FolderWrite
description: Request body for POST /folders (create) and PATCH /folders/{id} (rename / move / archive). Folders are user-created only — no endpoint creates folders as a side effect of extraction. Depth ≤ 3 enforced server-side (`422 folder_depth_exceeded`); renaming a folder is a bulk frontmatter rewrite of member notes (ADR 0005) and can be slow — the API stays async-tolerant.

allOf.description: Reserved names rejected (Rules.md §3). Guard duplicated intentionally with folder.json — the contract test asserts both lists stay identical.
